clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Barithras Moonshade seeks Scaber Stalks from a hidden cavern behind Cliffspring Falls.

Scaber Stalks grow in a subterranean cave behind Cliffspring Falls, among the northeastern mountains of Darkshore. The pale mushrooms thrive in the damp, secluded cave network, far from ordinary forest growth. Their remote, hazardous home makes them rare to gather, and Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine commissions scouts to brave its darkness.
